property_summary: For any uint56 changeFee input, after initialize(...) the contract's public changeFee equals the exact uint56 value passed in (i.e. stored unchanged); the mutant that increments the stored value by 1 will cause changeFee() != _changeFee for some fuzzed _changeFee inputs.
change_summary: Assigns a different value to changeFee by swapping assignment to set changeFee to _changeFee + 1 instead of _changeFee.
